_comment: Per-object grip force in raw FSR counts (3.3k divider), all on the STRONGER jaw (max of the two sensors). GRIP closes until the stronger jaw reaches 'target'; if EITHER jaw goes above 'max' the jaws back off at once. Strengths (hardcoded for now): 300 light, 500 medium, 700 firm. Measured Nov 22: the jaw nearer the object reads 2-4x the other; force rises ~70-100 counts per servo degree after contact, so keep >= 250 counts between target and max.
_names: Ids stay egg/cup/block (vision sends these); the console shows egg = Pill bottle, cup = Squeeze bottle, block = Pills.
